licence.frontierhunts.msg.ladder1: Written warning and a %2$s-token fine for %1$s. Tag every animal before you skin it or walk away. Next time your licence is suspended.
licence.frontierhunts.msg.ladder2: Second offence: %2$s-token fine for %1$s. Your licence is SUSPENDED for the rest of this licence season. One more and you are charged with poaching.
licence.frontierhunts.msg.ladder3: CHARGED WITH POACHING for %1$s: %2$s-token fine, licence REVOKED for a full reserve year, and the charge goes on your record. Every hunter on the reserve has been told.

licence.frontierhunts.tag.reminder: Tag it: hold your %s and use it on the animal before you skin it or walk away.
licence.frontierhunts.tag.first: Tag it first: hold your %s and use it on the animal, then skin it.
licence.frontierhunts.tag.wrong: That is not the right tag. This animal needs a %s (%s).
licence.frontierhunts.tag.reported: Too late to tag: the warden already has this one on file.
item.frontierhunts.permit.tag_use: Use it on the animal right after the shot: before you skin it, and before you walk away. An untagged kill goes on your warden record.
Warden record: every violation (no licence or tag, out of season, over the limit, an animal left untagged) is a point. 1: warning, fine, evidence seized. 2: licence suspended for the season. 3: charged with poaching - licence revoked for a reserve year, your name posted to all hunters. One point wears off per clean licence season.
Relaxed: fines are halved and you keep the animal, but a violation never counts for a species hunt.
Strict: full fines, and the trophy and half the meat of an illegal animal are seized as evidence.
